highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 updates to Skia m154 and ships XML API documentation with NuGet packages.
highlights_body: Package consumers can now receive compiler XML documentation, including API remarks authored in the C# source, alongside the managed assemblies.

bullets.detail: Aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome milestone 154 and incorporates upstream m154 bug fixes, including a buffer-upload fix.

bullets.lead: XML API documentation ships with packages
bullets.detail: Managed NuGet packages now include compiler XML documentation generated from C# API comments, improving IntelliSense and consumer-facing API reference content.

contributor_summaries.azchohfi: Improved the native HarfBuzz build warning suppression used by the package build.
